planning_notes: The request for 5 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the available pool and assigning them unique, high-cognitive-load assessment facets. To ensure non-redundancy, each target focuses on a different conceptual component of the Binary Search problem (Partitioning, Boundary Properties, Median Logic, Comparison Conditions, and Pointer Adjustment) and a different pedagogical angle (Off-by-One, Boundary Edge Cases, Theoretical Rationale, Error Diagnosis, and Output Prediction). This ensures comprehensive coverage of the lecture material at a challenging level.
